content: <thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbon atoms, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the `carbon_nmr_spectra` tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical shift ranges with `retrieve_carbon_shifts` to identify the aromatic region (approximately 120–150 ppm). By counting the peaks in the spectrum that fall within this aromatic range, I can report the number of aromatic carbons.
